de-county-officials.summary: The County card says which form of government the county has, and names none of its council, executive, levy court or other elected officers.
de-county-officials.why: No statewide list of Delaware's county officials has been read for this app yet, and the counties' own pages have not been read one by one.
de-county-officials.wanted: A list of each county's council, executive or levy court and its other elected officers, from the state or from the county itself.

de-municipal-officeholders.summary: The City, Town or Village card names the city, town or village you picked, and not its mayor or council members.
de-municipal-officeholders.why: No statewide list of the elected officials of Delaware's cities, towns and villages has been read for this app, and their own pages have not been read one by one.
de-municipal-officeholders.wanted: One statewide list of each city, town or village's mayor or council members, or a city, town or village's own published list of them.

de-school-board-members.summary: The School District card names the district you picked, and not the members of its school board.
de-school-board-members.why: No list of the members of Delaware's school boards has been read for this app, and the districts' own pages have not been read one by one.
de-school-board-members.wanted: One statewide list of each school district's board members, or a district's own published list of its board.
